text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Moments like this, even if...  
............"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. It's totally fine to have moments 
like this. Perfectly fine."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"............? ...Um, excuse me. Is that 
all the explanation there is?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Eh? Yep, that's it!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "THAT'S IT?!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, but honestly? I think I totally get 
what Sky-senpai means☆ 
Like, I feel like I get it, y'know?! Even 
if I don't totally get it☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
'Cause like, it was super! Super? Super 
seriously☆ 
SOOOOO much fun♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like finding a spot to nap! Ahaha! 
Wasn't that so silly and fun? The rules 
were totally made up, too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! We took tons of cat 
pics! And afteeer that... 
God-tier shots of Ai-chan and the kitty! 
Wanna see? Wanna see?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just chilling and watching the clouds is 
pretty great, right? That kinda stuff! 
Hey, hey, let's do it again, okay? 'Cause 
it was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I-I see?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: 'Cause it was fun... huh...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! By the way, by the way! I'm next, 
then☆ 
Let's all do what I wanna do♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's been on my mind for literally 
ever! We totally gotta do it♡ 
Our... Swimsuit Revenge!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, first off, it's summer, right? Not 
buying a swimsuit isn't even an option, is 
it? 
Isn't summer literally made for buying 
swimsuits?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... that's such a Pandora-chan way of 
thinking. Pretty much the polar opposite 
of me, who just draws manga in loungewear 
on days off.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what a waste! On a day off—omggg♡ 
I just got a lightning bolt of 
inspiration! This one's for you, 
Kiseki-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, me?! I feel like something sporty 
would suit me way better though...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay, this is definitely the one! If 
you wanna show off your charm, this is it! 
It'll suit you ten-billion percent. Come 
on, pleeease♡ Pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...Uuugh...! I'm definitely feeling 
pretty embarrassed! 
But... yeah. Maybe I should just take the 
plunge here.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I mean, if I don't... I'll never 
understand what Sky-senpai was talking 
about—and besides...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright. I'll go buy this swimsuit! 
—It really is super cute!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
See! Told! You! Sooooo!!!! It looks super 
good on youuu♡♡♡ 
We're the absolute best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, my face feels so hot! Wait, am I 
smiling? 
Am I smiling properly right now?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totally♡ You look so adorbs, Kiseki-chan! 
Come on, let's take a pic together! Look 
at the phone! Ayeeee☆

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa! I've done cosplay before, but... 
whoa! 
I hardly ever try to make *myself* cute 
like this!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(No, but... wait? 
What is this feeling? How should I put 
it...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...This might actually be fun?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...Maybe I should go shopping for clothes 
sometime?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was so much fun♡ Totally 
satisfied, totally satisfied~♡ 
Alright, what's next? Whose turn is it~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In that case, next is... Bright-san! 
Why don't we try doing something you came 
up with?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my? Me~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because just like me, you seem like 
you'd be good at it. 
Taking things easy and all that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...You are quite right. 
In that case, I would like to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Walk down this path~. 
Just strolling along, all the way until 
the road ends~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Every time I come to this training camp, I 
have always wondered~. 
Where exactly does this path lead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
??? "We do not have rice balls"? Um, 
Pandora-sama~. 
What does that sign mean, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! For real, that's hilarious. What 
kind of store is this even? 
Hey hey, wanna peek inside? Let's goooo☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. What a lovely bakery that was~. 
The entire shop was filled with the 
wonderful aroma of wheat~.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That place was amazing... Seeing a sign 
like that makes you instantly wonder what 
kind of shop it is! 
I really need to learn from catchy 
copywriting like that...

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
*sip, sip*... Phew~. 
*gulp, gulp*... Haaah~.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A drink I've never seen before, from a 
vending machine that barely looks like it 
works... 
I love this kind of thing! An encounter of 
the unknown, you could say!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Sparkling Tea." Carbonated green tea is 
certainly... very humorous, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~. To think there was a church in a 
place like this. 
I wonder if it is open at this hour~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Bright-san. The sun is starting to 
set, so... 
Maybe we should figure out how we're 
getting back...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes~. ...However, I am terribly sorry, 
Ai-sama~. I actually have had no idea 
where we are for quite a while now~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! You looked so calm that I 
totally assumed you knew where we were...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My heart has been fluttering with a tiny 
bit of nervous excitement wondering if we 
can make it back safely, you see~.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, worst-case scenario, we can always 
check the map on our phones. Since we 
still have time today, let's do everything 
Bright-senpai wants to do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah, this place is...! Whoa~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's the training camp! This path 
was connected to it all along?! Whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. What a relief. 
A familiar sight truly brings such peace 
of mind on its own, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I kind of feel a sense of accomplishment! 
...Even though all we did was follow an 
unfamiliar road and end up back at the 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even so, it was quite delightful~♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I really... spent the whole day doing 
absolutely nothing! And yet, 
why is it that I don't feel guilty at all? 
It's kind of strange...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, a message from Pandora on LANE. 
She shared some photos of me...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...So embarrassing. 
Looking at them again... I was totally 
acting like a kid.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Wait... but, wow... I'm smiling so much. 
Honestly, it felt like I was just being 
dragged around all day, but...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...This is actually really nice.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Alright, count me in too...!
